GF128: a quad

You will learn

The 128-bit GoldenFloat, 1 + 49 + 78, and the four invariants that hold its layout.

GF128 has 128 bits: 1 sign, 49 exponent, 78 mantissa. IEEE quad spends 15 bits on the exponent. The spec holds the layout with four invariants: the fields partition the word, the mantissa and the exponent follow the closed form, and the shifts follow the layout.

Try it

Read the four invariants of gf128.t27 and check SIGN_SHIFT and EXP_SHIFT against the field widths by hand.
